_meta: Real neighborhood spatial-deficit research (1/2-mile and 1-mile radius asset reports), reconciled 2026-07-12 against data/amenityData/amenity_needs.csv (transcribed from data/amenityData/andres/'s site-specific Amenity Needs Report). Each entry's target_volume_cuft assumes a 12ft baseline ceiling height for underground cassettes. Used by the excavation solver to match a puncture zone's volume against a real programmatic need. need_level (NEEDED / Suggested / Optional) is the report's own priority tier for that item, used by logic/program_placement.py to sequence bay-grid placement (Optional skipped by default). Fresh Food was assessed in the same report as Optional with 0 target_sf ('already served nearby') — no program entry exists for it since there's nothing to place.
_shade_meta: shade_target_pct applies only to surface-level/open program (green_space, sports_recreation, outdoor); enrichment_civic and health_care entries are enclosed cassette program, so shade is not applicable. Basis and unverified-claim caveats: archive/memoryMachine/LA Shade & Park Standards — Source Links.md. The three new `outdoor` entries below have no sourced shade standard yet (unlike green_space/sports_recreation) -- shade_target_pct left null with an explicit not-yet-sourced basis rather than guessing a number.

programs.label: Green Space & Park Infrastructure
programs.shade_basis: City of LA Landscape Ordinance No. 170,978 — 50% canopy coverage at 10yr growth, applied by analogy from its parking-lot standard to general hardscape/park surface.

programs.label: Community Garden
programs.shade_basis: Perimeter/seating shade only — planting beds need direct sun, so full-canopy standards don't apply; 25% covers edges and rest areas.

programs.label: Public Gym
programs.shade_basis: Not applicable — enclosed structure, not an open shade surface.
programs.double_height_basis: Gymnasium equipment/court clearance genuinely needs more than one standard level -- 2026-07-16, user-confirmed example program for the new program_boxes double-height extrusion; see logic/pershing_api.py's program_boxes docstring.

programs.label: Skatepark
programs.shade_basis: Perimeter shade target; full overhead canopy avoided so cast shadow lines don't create tripping hazards on the skating surface.
programs.double_height_basis: Vert ramps/bowls need more than one standard level of clearance -- 2026-07-16, user-confirmed example program for the new program_boxes double-height extrusion; see logic/pershing_api.py's program_boxes docstring.

programs.label: Volleyball Court
programs.shade_basis: Sideline/spectator shade only, same logic as soccer_field.

programs.label: Playground
programs.shade_basis: Not yet sourced — no LA standard identified for this program type; needs research before treating as a real target (see _shade_meta).

programs.label: Picnic / Grill Site
programs.shade_basis: Not yet sourced — no LA standard identified for this program type; needs research before treating as a real target (see _shade_meta).

programs.label: Workout Equipment
programs.shade_basis: Not yet sourced — no LA standard identified for this program type; needs research before treating as a real target (see _shade_meta).

programs.label: Restrooms (Metro Entrance)
programs.sizing_basis: Industry-typical public park restroom sizing (150+ sf multi-stall bracket per IPC fixture-ratio + ADA clearance guidance, user-supplied 2026-07-17) -- NOT from the real neighborhood-deficit assessment (data/amenityData/amenity_needs.csv has no restroom line item).

programs.label: Restrooms (Recreation Cluster)
programs.sizing_basis: Same industry-typical sizing basis as restrooms_metro, smaller multi-stall bracket -- serves the sports/outdoor/green-space cluster rather than the highest-traffic metro-adjacent zone.
